I will never recommend buying a second hand car from OM motors ever to anyone. If you still want to buy it , then please ensure to get a experienced mechanic along so that you don't get cheated like I was. Because blindly trusted whatever I was told about the car. I just regret this whole experience. I wish it would never had happened.
